# Test suite

* [Accessibility tests (axe and keyboard scripts)](accessibility-tests.md) - axe checks against WCAG 2.1 A and AA rules, keyboard-only Playwright scripts, and component-level focus and error-association checks cover the screens listed in NFR-001 and the not-found page.
* [API integration tests (JUnit and MockMvc)](api-integration-tests.md) - Spring Boot integration tests in api/src/test cover every API operation, error source, persistence, session behaviour and the password and filter-exception paths against a fresh SQLite file.
* [Architecture tests (ArchUnit)](architecture-tests.md) - ArchUnit rules fail the build on a module dependency cycle, on use of unpublished module types, on DataSource creation outside the composition root, or on a main class outside the listed packages, and a non-vacuity fixture proves each rule can fail.
* [Contract tests (OpenAPI request validator)](contract-tests.md) - Integration requests and responses are validated against the frozen identity and to-do OpenAPI files, and an endpoint inventory test checks that every mapped route is in exactly one module contract.
* [End-to-end tests (Playwright)](e2e-tests.md) - Playwright specs drive the real API and SPA through the main, restart and session-expiry configurations, covering the acceptance journey, auth, navigation, states, keyboard use, network locality and performance, on chromium and webkit.
* [Web component tests (Vitest and React Testing Library)](web-component-tests.md) - Component tests render the SPA's screens against a fake API and a stubbed session provider, covering the sign-up, log-in, list, form, navigation, error and accessibility behaviour.
* [Web unit tests (Vitest)](web-unit-tests.md) - Vitest unit tests check the whitespace table, the user-message mapping for every failure, and the routing helpers, in web/tests/unit.
